posts.author: jUnSOFT
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I felt it was about time I stopped lurking. I'm jUn (stylized as such for unknown reasons).
I'm an artist/composer/programmer who recently got (re)interested in RPG Maker and game development in general. I've known about RM in the early 2010s with XP, then in 2018 or so with MV. But it was around last year that I decided to take things seriously and focus purely on game development with it.
Now, I primarily use MZ along with Cutievirus' MZ3D plugin to create First Person Dungeon Crawlers - by far my favorite genre.
This February, I completed my first game - The Nian-Xi Chronicles: Prelude, a short 10 hour "Dark Fantasy"-ish DRPG which I'll post about later. I'm now currently working on my next project, which I expect will be much larger.
As for art and music: Though I've drawn fanart and made music covers for a long while (mostly Touhou & Castlevania), I now focus entirely on original content.
Game interests include First Person Dungeon Crawlers (or DRPGs to be more precise) as I said. Series like Wizardry, Etrian Odyssey, Class of Heroes and the early Megami Tensei games are my favorites and a huge influence for my projects. Though many DRPGs still come out to this day, I feel the genre doesn't get nearly as much recognition like it should.
I speak both English and Spanish, with Spanish being my first language. If you're interested in my works, including my art and music, you can check my links below.
Nice to meet you all!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Thanks for saying hi and a late welcome to the forum as well!
I love Wizardry 6-8. Easily in my top 10 favorites games of all time.
Awesome to hear that you are working on first person games in MZ. That is the genre that I want to make as well in the future.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
